tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Moon Insight 153
tutorial.welcome.text: This is a short tour of the buttons on the page. You can skip it at any time and watch it again from the menu, under “Tutorial”.
tutorial.locale.title: Language
tutorial.locale.text: Switches the whole page between Spanish (ES) and English (EN).
tutorial.site.title: Site
tutorial.site.text: Pick one of the nine areas near the Moon's south pole. The 3D scene and all the data change to the place you choose.
tutorial.view.title: Free view / Follow the rover
tutorial.view.text: In free view you drag to look around and use the wheel to zoom. “Follow the rover” puts the camera back behind the rover.
tutorial.lroc.title: LROC image
tutorial.lroc.text: Paints the ground with the light and dark patches seen in real photos from NASA's LRO probe. Turn it off to see the relief alone. Not available at Nobile Rim 1, Nobile Rim 2 or Leibnitz Beta Plateau.
tutorial.shadows.title: Lighten shadows
tutorial.shadows.text: At the south pole the Sun sits almost on the horizon and shadows are very dark. This button lightens them so you can see what they hide. It only changes how things look, not the data.
tutorial.sound.title: Sound
tutorial.sound.text: It starts off. Turn it on to hear a radio call when you reach a sign, a click when you press buttons, and a cue when the site's verdict changes.
tutorial.volume.title: Volume
tutorial.volume.text: Turns all the sound up or down: the music, the radio and the rover motor. You only hear it when sound is on.
tutorial.game.title: Game: Lunar Rescue Mission
tutorial.game.text: Takes you to a NASA game at the Moon's south pole: you help the crew complete five missions. It opens in the same language as the page (Spanish or English) and works offline. Inside the game, an “Moon Insight 153” button brings you back here.
tutorial.menu.title: Menu
tutorial.menu.text: Here you will find the Planner (figures, chart and limits for any date), Analysis (best dates and a comparison of the nine sites), Compare (two scenarios side by side) and this Tutorial.
tutorial.play.title: Play and pause
tutorial.play.text: Runs simulated time: the Sun and Earth move across the sky and shadows shift. Press it again to pause.
tutorial.skips.title: Time jumps
tutorial.skips.text: Move back or forward one hour or one day at once, to see what changes just before or after.
tutorial.timeline.title: Timeline
tutorial.timeline.text: Drag the bar to go to any moment between 2026 and 2030. The exact date and time (UTC) are shown above it.
tutorial.speed.title: Speed
tutorial.speed.text: Choose how much simulated time passes for each real second, from 1 hour to 30 days.
tutorial.scene.title: Drive the rover
tutorial.scene.text: Use W/A/S/D or the arrow keys (Shift to go faster). Reach the lander, within 25 m, and a sign opens with the story and data of the place. Happy exploring!
